build_patch_embedding: build a PatchEmbed module to convert image tensors into patch embeddings with configurable kernel size and stride
build_patch_merging: build a PatchMerging layer to downsample patch feature maps using nn.Unfold for Swin Transformer compatibility
build_multihead_attention: build a MultiheadAttention wrapper with identity connection and positional encoding support for transformer architectures
build_feedforward_network: build an FFN module with configurable fully-connected layers, activation functions, and optional LayerScale for transformer blocks
build_transformer_layer: build a BaseTransformerLayer with customizable operation order supporting prenorm, self-attention, cross-attention, and FFN
